The house method

A single calm system for every threshold.

The program is organized around the thresholds mothers actually cross: preconception, pregnancy, birth, and the first tender weeks after.

Start before birth starts.

Holistic fertility and preconception preparation help women enter pregnancy with steadier habits, clearer expectations, and less panic.

Turn preparation into a rhythm.

Bite-size video lessons, checklists, and a community format make the work feel possible around real days, appointments, and family life.

Know what you want and why.

Birth planning becomes more than a template: women learn interventions, options, mindset, energy, and advocacy before the room gets intense.

Carry peace into the fourth trimester.

Postpartum, lactation, and partner training make the weeks after birth part of the plan, not an afterthought.

Before you enroll

The practical questions.

The design makes objections easy to scan without burying the offer under a wall of answers.

How do I access the course?

Everything operates through Skool.com, on your laptop or the free Skool mobile app. Once enrollment is confirmed, you receive the link to join.

When should I start?

Anytime, from preconception through pregnancy. Many mamas enroll between 20 and 32 weeks, and lifetime access means you can revisit lessons later.

Is this like a free hospital class?

No. Hospital classes often focus on logistics. This course covers nutrition, mindset, birth planning, postpartum, lactation, partner support, and fertility.

Joy Within Birth: faith-centered natural childbirth training and community.
